description: This file defines an interface class IGstWebAudioPlayerPrivate within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. The class declares pure virtual methods for changing the pipeline state and stopping a worker thread, indicating it is intended for implementation by classes managing GStreamer web audio playback functionality.
